root_cause_or_summary: The agent misunderstood the task as predicting a single next lab test rather than the full set of tests in the next lab draw. Despite seeing that midnight draws consistently contained 50-60 simultaneous tests (CBC, CMP, LFTs, coags, urinalysis, differentials), the agent focused on which single test would appear first, returning only ALT instead of the complete panel.
